title: Live Listings Counted on a Professional Enrollment — Host Accounts
content:
# Desk Guidance — Live-Listing Count of an Enrollment (Host Accounts)

The live-listing count of an enrollment of a Host Accounts holder in the professional programmes is worked out from the host's Listings records by one of three methods:

1. **Registration reinstatements pending.** For an account with registration-suspended listings whose reinstatement requests are submitted and still undecided, it is the listed and snoozed listings plus one listing for each such request.
2. **Recent restriction.** For any other account whose restricted-until date falls within the 12 months before the enrollment, it is the listed listings only; snoozed listings are not counted.
3. For every other account neither of these methods applies.

The 12 months hold the dates fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of the enrollment.

## Records read

| Listings record | What is read |
|---|---|
| Listings of the host | Status: listed, snoozed |
| Listing reinstatement requests | Requests to lift a registration suspension that are still submitted, not approved or denied |
| Host account | The restricted-until date |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Listed | Snoozed | Registration reinstatement requests still submitted | Restricted-until date | Live-listing count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | 2 | 2 | none | 22 and 2, plus 2: **26** |
| 22 | 2 | 1 | 5 months before the enrollment | 22 and 2, plus 1: **25** (method 1 applies first) |
| 23 | 3 | 0 | 5 months before the enrollment | **23** (listed only) |
| 23 | 3 | 0 | 14 months before the enrollment | Neither method applies |

A reinstatement request that is about a suspension other than a registration suspension, or that has already been approved or denied, does not add a listing.
